service.description: The color of each status by its meaning (style-guide §5.2): grey for draft and proposed, primary for in progress, warning for waiting, positive for done well, negative for ended badly, info for informational. The work effort and request statuses are named; any other status gets a color from the words of its id.

The stage row of a record's status: the stages (stageStatusIds in order; a current status that is not one of them, such as On Hold or Cancelled, shows after the last stage reached) each with its label, color and state (done, current or todo), and the transitions of the status flow (StatusFlowTransition of statusFlowId, else Default) from the current status that the user may take (allowedToStatusIds; all of them when it is not given), each with its label (the transition name) and color. next is the primary action: the transition to the first stage after the current one, or with a current status off the stages the transition to the earliest stage (Resume, Re-open); the others are in transitions with isNext false.
